title: A11 Fidelity Guard verdict
description: pass or block on the fidelity gate, sentence level, with reasons. A block names the sentence it broke, by id or by quoting it, and the fault: a binding that resolves to no declared element, a claim that traces to no graph element, a lexicon or future-tense-harm violation. The `token` field is minted by the runner over the candidate bytes on a pass, never by the slot.

reasons.description: On a block, one entry per faulty sentence: locale, sentence id, and what does not trace.

token.description: Written by the runner, never by the slot.

model.description: The identity the agent reports from its own system context.
